Maya — appreciate the clear ask and redline. Quick responses and next steps below.

Summary answers:
- Split invoicing: Yes — we can support split invoices by region (one invoice to BrightCloud, Inc.; one to BrightCloud EU GmbH). We typically require separate billing contacts and PO numbers. We will record both billing entities on the order form and route invoices accordingly.
- VAT responsibility: By default Redwood treats tax responsibility per local law; for EU customers we normally apply VAT where applicable and provide VAT registration when requested. If BrightCloud wants to self-assess (reverse charge), we need the EU VAT registration for BrightCloud and a signed VAT declaration.

Maya / Tom — thanks. Quick update and plan so we can close the order form this week:

1) Redwood confirmation: we will support split invoicing and list both billing entities on the final order form. Redwood will issue separate invoices per entity and accept two PO numbers.

2) VAT handling: Vanessa attached Redwood's VAT registration and wrote the short statement below: 

---
Redwood VAT statement (summary): Redwood Inference is registered for VAT in applicable jurisdictions. For cross-border services where BrightCloud is VAT-registered in the receiving country, BrightCloud may elect to self-assess under reverse charge. In such cases Redwood will zero-rate the invoice upon receipt of BrightCloud's valid VAT registration and a signed reverse charge declaration. Otherwise Redwood will apply VAT per local tax law and include corresponding tax on the invoice.
---

Attachments included: BrightCloud_Redlined_OrderForm_v3.pdf (from BrightCloud), BrightCloud_VAT_certificate.pdf (BrightCloud-provided), Redwood_VAT_registration.pdf (Redwood-provided).

3) Net terms: Proposed Net 45; Sean to ask finance if Net 30 is acceptable for this specific deal (D-78934-BR) — if BrightCloud requires Net 30 we will need approval and it may change invoice cadence.
